inputs.text: Graduation belongs to the students and families who earned that moment through discipline and hard work—not to anyone seeking attention through disruption. If the university failed administratively, it should answer for that plainly through proper channels. But turning a ceremony into a spectacle and calling it courage weakens respect for order and teaches the wrong lesson: that making noise matters more than responsibility.
